prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning beds or spray/airbrush tanning? And what matters most — lowest price, best spray tan artist, newest equipment, or highest-rated cleanliness/service?

I don’t have live web access to pull current reviews, but I can help you find the best salon near you and what to look for. Quick guidance:

How to choose the best tanning salon
- Decide type: spray/airbrush (safer, immediate results) vs. UV beds (fades over time, higher skin-cancer risk).  
- Check recent local reviews (Google Maps, Yelp, Facebook) — look for 4+ stars and many recent reviews.  
- Call and ask:
  - For spray tans: ask about products used, technician experience, before/after photos, custom color matching, prep and aftercare instructions.  
  - For UV: ask bed types (high-pressure vs low-pressure), session length, skin-type assessment, staff training, and whether they enforce skin-type limits.  
- Visit in person: look for cleanliness, well-maintained equipment, professional staff, and visible licensing/certifications.  
- Compare pricing/memberships and first-time specials.  
- Ask about safety measures (sanitizing between clients, ventilation) and patch-test options for spray tans.

Safety tips
- Dermatologists recommend spray tans instead of UV tanning to avoid increased skin-cancer risk.  
- If you use UV beds, limit sessions, follow staff guidance, and never tan with medication or sunburned skin.  
- Use moisturizing and gentle exfoliation to extend spray-tan life.

If you want, tell me: spray or UV, and your ZIP code or neighborhood in Tyler. I can then give a short list of well-reviewed salons (based on recent review lookups you can run) and sample questions to ask each one.
